name: max_eig_path_4
description: 4x4 SDP: max <C,X> s.t. tr(X)=1, X 4x4 PSD, C = tridiagonal Toeplitz T_4(2,1) (diagonal 2, off-diagonal 1). By the variational formula opt = lambda_max(C) = 2 + 2 cos(pi/5). Optimal X* is the rank-1 projector onto the top eigenvector (singular, boundary optimum). Scalable size-stress family (n=4,8,16).
reference_method: Closed form lambda_max(T_n(2,1)) = 2 + 2 cos(pi/(n+1)); n=4. Cross-checked in mpmath 1.3.0 and sympy 1.14.0 against an explicit symmetric eigensolve to >60 digits.

known_gaps.reason: measured bits/digit = final_prec/matched_digits = 512/13.88 = 37 >> goal 8 (final_prec 512, matched 13.88 digits vs 65-digit golden at PREC=8192, 5 iters); NUM trajectory 128:NUM:3.3 256:NUM:7.3 512:OPT. Layer-0 radius/precision overrun, bead epic.6.
